name: virtual-grid
title: Virtual Grid
description: Items in columns, too many to render all: a grid of rows, or masonry (each item in the shortest column, as tall as it is, so pictures of any shape are whole). As many columns as fit, up to 12 as many as divide 12 (2, 3, 4 or 6: on the 12-column grid); heights measured, fractions too, and laid out again as a width, a font size or an image changes. Scrolls to and focuses an item by its key, asks for the next page near the end, keeps its place while hidden, and the arrow keys move between items by where they are, past those the app skips (skip).
